node.statement: Because C is a finite nonempty equivalence class, choose an enumeration C={j_1,...,j_q}, q=|C|, and put U_r={j_1,...,j_r}. Ordinary finite induction reduces the asserted construction for all 1 <= r <= q to the singleton case r=1 and the successor implication from U_r to U_{r+1}.
